# Third-party components

OptiMiyoo bundles these tools for Windows conversion. Each has its own authors
and license; source archives and build details are linked below.

These component licenses do not define a license for OptiMiyoo's own code.

## [NIBTools](https://github.com/rittwage/nibtools)

C64 NIB/NBZ to G64 conversion. Bundled version: **20241120**.

[License](nibtools/LICENSE.txt) · [Source and build](nibtools/SOURCE.txt)

## [HxC Floppy Emulator](https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator)

ZX Spectrum IPF to DSK conversion. Bundled version: **2.16.13.1**.

[Notices](hxc/COPYING_FULL) · [Source and build](hxc/SOURCE.txt)

## [CAPSIMG](https://github.com/FrodeSolheim/capsimg)

Decodes IPF images for HxC. This is the SPS Decoder Library adapted by Frode
Solheim for FS-UAE. Bundled Windows versions: **5.1.3 x64** and **5.1fs3 x86**.

[License](capsimg/LICENSE.txt) · [Source](capsimg/SOURCE.txt)

**CAPSIMG's included license restricts commercial use.**

## [GCC](https://gcc.gnu.org/) / [MinGW-w64](https://www.mingw-w64.org/)

Runtime libraries for x86 CAPSIMG, packaged by [MSYS2](https://github.com/msys2/MINGW-packages).

[Package list](runtime/packages.json) · [Licenses and packages](runtime/SOURCE.txt)
